title: ActGov: Governing LLM Agent Actions via Policy-Constrained Validation
abstract: arXiv:2609.24446v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute long-horizon workflows through external tools, allowing untrusted outputs to influence subsequent actions and exceed user authorization. Existing defenses isolate injected content or constrain execution with predefined plans and static policies, but these approaches are brittle under dynamic workflows and scale poorly across extensible tool ecosystems.   In this work, we present ActGov, a runtime enforcement framework that validates each LLM-proposed tool action before it causes external effects. Built on a unified semantic model of authorization, actions, runtime context, and security constraints, the ActGov-Policy component iteratively constructs a policy set from tool specifications, benign tasks, and observed failure traces, with each update verified through SMT-based counterexample checking. translated_title: ActGov：通过策略约束验证来治理LLM智能体行为
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过外部工具执行长时程工作流，这使得不可信的输出能够影响后续操作并超出用户授权范围。现有的防御方法要么隔离注入的内容，要么通过预定义计划和静态策略来约束执行，但这些方法在动态工作流下表现脆弱，且难以在可扩展的工具生态系统中规模化。在本工作中，我们提出了ActGov，这是一个运行时强制执行框架，在每个LLM提议的工具操作产生外部影响之前对其进行验证。ActGov建立在授权、操作、运行时上下文和安全约束的统一语义模型之上，其ActGov-Policy组件从工具规范、良性任务和观察到的失败轨迹中迭代构建策略集，每次更新都通过基于SMT的反例检查进行验证。在运行时，ActGov-Runtime将每个工具调用抽象为有限策略记录和每个……
tldr: ActGov是一个运行时强制执行框架，通过从工具规范、良性任务和失败轨迹中迭代构建并经SMT反例检查验证的策略集，在LLM智能体的工具操作产生外部影响之前对其进行验证，从而有效治理动态工作流下的智能体行为安全。
en_tdlr: ActGov is a runtime enforcement framework that validates each LLM-proposed tool action before it causes external effects, using a policy set iteratively constructed from tool specifications, benign tasks, and failure traces with SMT-based counterexample verification, enabling robust governance of agent actions in dynamic workflows.
